supersedes: op3-awdc-logs-8433-v2.json through its v4 addendum; logged data and original OP3 seed/evaluation contracts remain fixed

prior_result_disposition.v1_to_v3: Stopped before a complete extraction because critic cost and memory use exceeded the machine's limits; defects and changes are recorded in the v2 manifest addenda.
prior_result_disposition.v4_seed0: Completed but INVALID as an AWDC result. Legal and illegal logits were both replaced by -1e9; the masked mean included -inf for illegal actions, forcing all AWDC weights to clip at 20.0. All four checkpoint dev means were exactly -4189.10 (Sleep arm). Preserve these artifacts as defect evidence; do not include them in v5 statistics or reuse the BC evaluation.

v5_correctness_repairs: masked logits preserve the legal logits and set only illegal logits to -1e9, in BC, AWDC and greedy evaluation
V(s) averages Q over valid actions only; advantage weights are exp(A/tau), normalized within each state over valid actions using a stable exponent, then clipped to [0,20]
TD bootstraps use the next tick's mask for the same Blue agent
the conservative term uses masked-sample logsumexp vs Q(s,a_logged), with gradients to sampled Q values
G2 is checked immediately after a fresh BC evaluation; a BC mean more than 1.0 ahead of frozen guard mean -127.80 aborts extraction
BC, AWDC-1, AWDC-2 and final actor state_dict checkpoints are written outside Git with SHA-256 hashes in the extraction manifest

unchanged_pre_registered_contract.dev_seeds: 8445-8464 inclusive; finite Red, 400 native steps, native return
unchanged_pre_registered_contract.actor: per-agent MLP: 867->64->64->155, BC epochs 3 at lr 1e-3
unchanged_pre_registered_contract.critic: Q over joint Blue-visible observations (5x867), agent one-hot, embedded action; hidden 128, alpha 0.1, K=8 masked samples, gamma 0.99; 12 TD epochs on a deterministic 33% row subsample per extraction seed
unchanged_pre_registered_contract.awdc: tau 1.0, clip [0,20], AWDC-1 after 4 weighted epochs, AWDC-2 after 8, final after 16; lr 1e-4
unchanged_pre_registered_contract.h1_success: final mean native return >= guard mean - 1.0; report paired bootstrap and per-RNG-seed spread; no confirm suite unless gate passes and a fresh seed audit is clean

preflight: 6 focused tests passed and a 128-agent-row real-log batch completed TD loss backward and produced finite normalized AWDC weights (mean 0.998 before fitted critic).
